question: 第二季度各地区扣除已支付退款后的净销售额是多少？
sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT region_id, SUM(total_cents) AS sales_cents FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-04-01' AND created_at < '2026-07-01' AND status='completed' GROUP BY region_id), refund_totals AS (SELECT o.region_id, SUM(f.amount_cents) AS refunded_cents FROM refunds f JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=f.order_id WHERE f.created_at >= '2026-04-01' AND f.created_at < '2026-07-01' AND f.status='paid' GROUP BY o.region_id) SELECT r.name AS region, sales.sales_cents-COALESCE(refund_totals.refunded_cents, 0) AS net_sales_cents FROM sales JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=sales.region_id LEFT JOIN refund_totals ON refund_totals.region_id=sales.region_id ORDER BY net_sales_cents DESC

question: 第二季度各品类平均每笔完成订单售出多少件？

question: 第二季度华南区销售额和退款率分别是多少？
sql: WITH sales_totals AS (SELECT SUM(o.total_cents) AS sales_cents FROM orders o JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=o.region_id WHERE r.area='South China' AND o.created_at >= '2026-04-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-07-01' AND o.status='completed'), refund_totals AS (SELECT SUM(f.amount_cents) AS refunded_cents FROM refunds f JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=f.order_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=o.region_id WHERE r.area='South China' AND f.created_at >= '2026-04-01' AND f.created_at < '2026-07-01' AND f.status='paid') SELECT sales_totals.sales_cents, ROUND(100.0*refund_totals.refunded_cents/sales_totals.sales_cents, 2) AS refund_rate_pct FROM sales_totals CROSS JOIN refund_totals

question: 前文：第二季度华南区销售额和退款率分别是多少？追问：其中哪个城市的退款率最高？
sql: WITH sales_by_region AS (SELECT r.name AS region, SUM(o.total_cents) AS sales_cents FROM orders o JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=o.region_id WHERE r.area='South China' AND o.created_at >= '2026-04-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-07-01' AND o.status='completed' GROUP BY r.name), refund_by_region AS (SELECT r.name AS region, SUM(f.amount_cents) AS refunded_cents FROM refunds f JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=f.order_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=o.region_id WHERE r.area='South China' AND f.created_at >= '2026-04-01' AND f.created_at < '2026-07-01' AND f.status='paid' GROUP BY r.name) SELECT s.region, ROUND(100.0*refund_by_region.refunded_cents/s.sales_cents, 2) AS refund_rate_pct FROM sales_by_region s JOIN refund_by_region ON refund_by_region.region=s.region ORDER BY refund_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 1

question: 前文：六月完成订单销售额和当月已支付退款额分别是多少？追问：退款率呢？

question: 前文：第二季度华南区销售额和退款率分别是多少？追问：广州销售额占华南区的比例是多少？

question: 第二季度各品类商品的加权平均成交单价是多少？

question: 第二季度完成订单销售额前三的商品是什么？

question: 第二季度各地区已支付退款订单数占完成订单数的比例是多少？
sql: WITH completed AS (SELECT region_id,COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-04-01' AND created_at < '2026-07-01' AND status='completed' GROUP BY region_id), refunded AS (SELECT o.region_id,COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS refunded_orders FROM orders o JOIN refunds f ON f.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.created_at >= '2026-04-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-07-01' AND o.status='completed' AND f.created_at >= '2026-04-01' AND f.created_at < '2026-07-01' AND f.status='paid' GROUP BY o.region_id) SELECT r.name AS region,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(refunded.refunded_orders,0)/completed.completed_orders,2) AS refunded_order_rate_pct FROM completed JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=completed.region_id LEFT JOIN refunded ON refunded.region_id=completed.region_id ORDER BY r.name

question: 第二季度完成订单销售额最高的客户及其销售额占比是多少？
sql: WITH customer_sales AS (SELECT user_id,SUM(total_cents) AS sales_cents FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-04-01' AND created_at < '2026-07-01' AND status='completed' GROUP BY user_id), ranked AS (SELECT user_id,sales_cents,SUM(sales_cents) OVER () AS all_sales FROM customer_sales) SELECT user_id,sales_cents,ROUND(100.0*sales_cents/all_sales,2) AS sales_share_pct FROM ranked ORDER BY sales_cents DESC,user_id LIMIT 1

question: 第二季度各地区不同订单状态的订单数和订单金额分别是多少？
